blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these equal negative three times the quantity x minus two? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the expressions equal to −3(x − 2).

blocks.text: Negative three x plus six. Negative three times x is negative three x, and negative three times negative two is positive six. Right.
Negative three x minus six makes the six negative. But negative three times negative two is positive six. Not a match.
Six minus three x has the same terms as negative three x plus six, in another order. Right.
Negative three x minus two multiplies only the x. The negative two needs the negative three too. Not a match.
The opposite of the quantity three x minus six changes both signs. That is negative three x plus six. Right.
Three times the quantity two minus x is six minus three x. Right.

Four of them are equal: negative three x plus six, six minus three x, the opposite of the quantity three x minus six, and three times the quantity two minus x. The negative three multiplies both terms, and the minus times minus makes plus six.
